description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [100% Critical], [Attach Water with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Sharpshooter Mode I (Tidus)] and [Water Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Sharpshooter Mode I (Tidus)
description.text: Sharpshooter abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Sharpshooter abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for Sharpshooter abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Sharpshooter Mode II (Tidus)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Sharpshooter Mode II (Tidus)
description.text: Instant cast speed, Water attacks deal 50% more damage, critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3
